room_sfm.note: bundle-adjusted SfM sparse model of the room (main model)

room_sfm_work.note: map.json, map_images.json and the attached cameras' sub-models

room_features.note: cached ALIKED features of every map image (index the model's 2D points)

room_keyframes.note: map keyframes (jpg + keyframes.json) and their people masks

room_map_frames.note: the map's window images (not keyframes) with their frames.json and masks

world_frame.note: world_from_sfm.json: gravity, floor and the betas-corrected scale (Sim3)

scale_reference.note: the scale reference the world frame inherits (betas rest heights vs statures)

camera_clocks.note: alignment_studio.json: affine audio clock of every phone on the reference clock

clock_gauge.note: the reference take's measured per-camera video offsets (segment sync is gauge-pinned to them)

betas.note: per-dancer body shape pinned in every fit (MAMMA_INIT_BETAS / MAMMA_FREEZE_BETAS format)

refine_recipe.note: pose_refine parameters of the accepted recipe (smplx_rf2_noslip)

skeleton.note: SMPL-X joint set + parameter layout + ma_3d settings + pinning rule

ma3d_config.note: the MAMMA ma_3d config template the reference fit used (contact config + overrides)

avatar.note: avatar configuration: shape edits and texture / groom / shoe file hashes (references)
